SELECT v.STRUCTURE_NAME, v.MATERIAL_CODE, v.MATERIAL_DESC, v.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC, v.MOULD_QTY, v.NET_DEMAND_QTY, v.SCHEDULE_QTY, v.ONBOARD_DATE, v.UNQUALIFIED_QTY, v.PRODUCTION_QTY, v.LH_MARGIN, v.EXPECTED_CLOSE_DAY, v.EXPECTED_CLOSE_DATE, v.EXPECTED_CLOSE_DATE, v.DIFF_DAY, r.CX_MACHINE_CODE AS CX_MACHINE, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct LH_MACHINE_CODE) AS LH_MACHINE FROM t_mp_month_plan_monitor v LEFT join T_MP_MOULDING_DAY_RESULT r ON r.PRODUCTION_VERSION = v.PRODUCTION_VERSION AND r.MATERIAL_CODE = v.MATERIAL_CODE AND r.IS_DELETE = 0 LEFT join t_lh_schedule_result lh ON lh.MONTH_PLAN_NO = v.PRODUCTION_VERSION AND lh.PRODUCT_CODE = v.MATERIAL_CODE AND lh.IS_DELETE = 0 WHERE v.year = #{year} AND v.month = #{month} AND v.factory_code = #{factoryCode}
AND r.CX_MACHINE_CODE like concat('%', #{cxMachine}, '%')
AND v.STRUCTURE_NAME = #{structureName}
AND LH_MACHINE_CODE like concat('%', #{lhMachine}, '%')
AND v.MATERIAL_CODE like concat('%', #{materialCode}, '%')
AND v.MATERIAL_DESC like concat('%', #{materialDesc}, '%')
AND v.IS_DELETE = 0 GROUP BY v.STRUCTURE_NAME, v.MATERIAL_CODE, v.MATERIAL_DESC, v.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC, v.MOULD_QTY, v.NET_DEMAND_QTY, v.SCHEDULE_QTY, v.ONBOARD_DATE, v.UNQUALIFIED_QTY, v.PRODUCTION_QTY, v.LH_MARGIN, v.EXPECTED_CLOSE_DAY, v.EXPECTED_CLOSE_DATE, v.EXPECTED_CLOSE_DATE, v.DIFF_DAY, r.CX_MACHINE_CODE
